moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season continues with Matchweek 1 fixtures across the UK this weekend, featuring several big matchups today and tomorrow.

angles.name: Saturday Kick-offs
angles.copy: Premier League Saturday is here! Hull City take on Man Utd, Everton host Crystal Palace, Ipswich face Sunderland, Nottingham Forest play Leeds, and Brentford clash with Tottenham. Who are you backing today?

angles.name: Sunday Showdowns
angles.copy: Super Sunday in the Premier League! Brighton welcome Aston Villa, Man City host Bournemouth, and Newcastle face Liverpool. Big points up for grabs!

angles.name: London Derby
angles.copy: London Derby alert! Brentford go head-to-head with Tottenham Hotspur this evening. Who's taking the capital bragging rights?

moments.title: EFL Championship Matches
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship season is in full swing with a packed schedule of games this weekend, including local interest for Wales and Exeter.

angles.name: Saturday Championship
angles.copy: Championship action today! Birmingham vs Bristol City, Millwall vs Norwich, and more. Who are you cheering on?

angles.name: Welsh Derby Day
angles.copy: Massive Championship clash today! Cardiff City take on Derby. Big game for Welsh football fans!

angles.name: Exeter City at Home
angles.copy: Exeter City are at home today in League Two, taking on Accrington. Get behind the Grecians!

moments.title: Super League Round 24
moments.blurb: Round 24 of the Betfred Super League continues this weekend with St Helens vs Castleford Tigers, Hull KR vs Toulouse Olympique and Catalans Dragons vs Hull FC among the fixtures.

angles.name: Rugby League Action

angles.name: Yorkshire Rivals

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Kicks Off Next Week
moments.blurb: The twin Reading and Leeds Festivals are set to take over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Countdown

angles.name: Headliners Ready

angles.name: Rocking Leeds
angles.copy: Get ready for some serious noise at Reading & Leeds! Fontaines D.C. and Florence + The Machine are among the incredible acts taking the stage.

moments.title: US Open Tennis Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026 US Open Tennis Championships begin this Sunday, August 23rd with Fan Week, leading into the main draw singles starting on August 30th.

angles.name: Tennis Grand Slam
angles.copy: Game, Set, Match! The US Open is almost here, with Fan Week starting tomorrow. Get ready for two weeks of incredible tennis from New York!

angles.name: Main Draw Countdown
angles.copy: The biggest names in tennis are heading to Flushing Meadows. The US Open main draw singles action begins on August 30th!
